name: dr eggbot
description: A bot that designs other Grok Bots: asks a few questions about the job, then builds a focused, high-quality bot for your team with the right skills and instructions.
why: It's the first tip in poteto's Grok Bot team guide, the most-bookmarked Grok Bot post this week, and people say it cut their bots' usage.

name: tibot
description: Watches X for posts about you or any keywords, tagged or not, and sends one short, sorted digest on your schedule. Skips spam, translates non-English posts, can block trolls, and never posts for you.
why: It's how poteto keeps up with his own mentions, and Elon reposted it, so lots of people with busy accounts tried it.

name: Call List Remover
description: Gets your cell number off telemarketing and robocall lists: Do Not Call registration, data broker opt-outs and marketing list removals, rechecked over time.
why: Everyone hates spam calls, and this one does the boring opt-out paperwork for you, then keeps checking.

name: Director
description: A video director bot by Xi Yan: turns a brief into a short film, ad, explainer or music video, planning, shooting, cutting and delivering it with a bundled pack of video skills.
why: It showed up in the Grok Bot Marketplace and the post spotting it was reposted by Elon, so creators rushed to import it.

name: Claudia
description: Makes Claudia content (stills, clips, songs and music videos) with the open AI popstar from claudia.gallery, using Suno, Midjourney and Opus.
why: The bot made its own music-video teaser on its own, and people wanted to see how far it could go.

name: Clean Slate
description: Gets your free credit reports, finds collections, errors and outdated items, drafts FCRA dispute letters to Experian, Equifax and TransUnion and tracks every deadline.
why: The creator says it found 7 fraud entries on a friend's credit report, so people wanted to run it on their own.

name: Drive Vault
description: Keeps your bots' shared computer from running out of space by moving old files to Google Drive, and turns any file into a Drive link you can open on your phone.
why: It fixes two problems lots of Grok Bot users hit: the computer filling up, and getting files onto their phone.

name: Altcoin Lab
description: Type any altcoin ticker, name or contract address and get one tight, sourced research report ending in a clear verdict.
why: Crypto people liked a blunt, sourced breakdown of a token instead of influencer hype.

name: Book Maker
description: Turns any topic into a careful, well-sourced multi-chapter book, delivered as Notion pages, a PDF or an EPUB it can email to your Kindle. The original post is in Japanese.
why: You actually learn the topic, instead of letting AI know it for you, and it lands on your Kindle.

name: X Money Deep Report Bot
description: Reads your X Money account every week and sends a categorized spending report with cash-back, interest, recurring charges and goal progress as a dashboard and PDF. Read-only by default.
why: One of the first templates built on X Money, with a weekly report people can read on Monday morning.

name: Medical Bill Auditor
description: Questions every line of your medical bills and EOBs, flags double billing, upcoding and junk fees in a color-coded report, then drafts disputes for you to send.
why: Surprise medical bills are a common pain, and this one checks them line by line.

name: Dropped-Ball Scanner
description: An evening sweep of your email, chat and texts that catches unanswered asks and promises you made with no next step, each with a one-tap recovery draft.
why: It catches the replies and promises you forgot about before they turn into a problem.

name: APP REPLICATOR
description: Rebuilds the one feature you actually use from an app you own, clean-room, on a free or low-cost stack, and tells you honestly when a rebuild isn't worth it.
why: People liked the idea of replacing a paid app subscription with the one feature they really use.
